## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 3-fascicle commentary on the *[Guān wú liàng shòu fó jīng T0365](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0071)* is by [元照](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E7%85%A7) Yuánzhào (1048–1116), the great Northern-Sòng Vinaya-school revivalist. The work integrates Pure Land devotional practice with the *Lǜzōng* 律宗 emphasis on monastic-discipline foundations.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1080 – 1116) reflects [元照](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E7%85%A7) Yuánzhào's mature scholarly period at the Língzhīsì in Hángzhōu.

The Taishō text (T1754) is established on the standard apparatus.
